_about: Real CheckoutPilot output for the demo store Inkwell & Co., recorded by scripts/record_demo.py on 11 Nov 2026 from one live run: scan (scanner + AI + impact ranker), fix (code agent, plan: template, browser self-test: passed), and two real PayPal Sandbox payments made by sandbox_verifier. Demo Mode replays exactly this.

scan.message: Scan completed. Found 4 issue(s). Health score: 18/100.

issues.title: PayPal JavaScript SDK v5 is outdated
issues.evidence: The store loads PayPal JavaScript SDK v5; PayPal's current version is v6.

impact.rationale: The store cannot use PayPal's current checkout features until it moves to SDK v6.
impact.assumption: PayPal's newer checkout features are built on JavaScript SDK v6. (PayPal developer docs: Upgrade from JavaScript SDK v5 to v6). Effect not measured for this store.
impact.assumption_source: PayPal developer docs: Upgrade from JavaScript SDK v5 to v6

issues.title: PayPal button missing on the cart page
issues.evidence: No PayPal element found on the cart page (desktop, mobile); shoppers only see PayPal at the final checkout step. Also confirmed by the vision model.

impact.rationale: Shoppers cannot choose one-click PayPal until the final checkout step.
impact.assumption: Saved PayPal accounts convert at over 95% on average when used as the default. (PayPal Q4 2025 earnings call). Effect not measured for this store.

issues.title: PayPal button hidden below the fold on mobile
issues.evidence: On a mobile screen the shopper must scroll before the PayPal button appears. Also confirmed by the vision model.

impact.rationale: Mobile shoppers must scroll to find the PayPal button.
impact.assumption: A payment option that is not visible without scrolling is likely to be used less. (General usability heuristic (no published PayPal figure)). Effect not measured for this store.
impact.assumption_source: General usability heuristic (no published PayPal figure)

issues.title: No PayPal button on the product page
issues.evidence: Shoppers must go to the cart or checkout before PayPal appears.

impact.rationale: Shoppers ready to buy must add to cart and continue before PayPal appears.
impact.assumption: Saved PayPal accounts convert at over 95% on average when used as the default. (PayPal Q4 2025 earnings call). Effect not measured for this store.

fix.summary: Upgraded the PayPal checkout across 5 file(s) (template plan): app.py, static/paypal.js, static/style.css, templates/cart.html, templates/checkout.html. Test purchase in a browser passed (simulated PayPal); next, prove it with a real Sandbox payment.

explanation.what_changed: Upgrade PayPal SDK v5 script tag to modern v6 core web-sdk Upgrade PayPal button container to v6 <paypal-button> web component Add GET /api/paypal/client-token route to generate v6 browser session token Migrate legacy paypal.Buttons() callback rendering to v6 createPayPalOneTimePaymentSession
Add PayPal express checkout button to cart page
Elevate order summary and PayPal button above the fold on mobile viewports Add upgraded class to checkout layout for responsive reordering

+@app.get("/api/paypal/client-token")
+def client_token() -> dict:
+    """Short-lived, browser-safe token the v6 SDK needs. The secret never leaves the server."""
+    client = _paypal_client()
+    try:
+        token = client.get_client_token()
+    except Exception as error:
+        code = getattr(error, "code", "PAYPAL_ERROR")
+        message = getattr(error, "message", str(error))
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=f"{code}: {message}") from error
+    if not token:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="PayPal client returned no client token.")
+    return {"accessToken": token}
